The Mummy Returns is back after 25 years. Get your tickets for the re-release, in theaters March 27.
______ 
Universal Pictures is proud to announce the nationwide theatrical re-release of The Mummy Returns, director Stephen Sommers’ rollicking sequel to 1999’s Oscar®-nominated blockbuster hit, The Mummy. To mark the film’s 25th anniversary, the action-packed adventure returns to theaters across the country on March 27, 2026 for a very special limited engagement.
 
Advance ticket sales launch today, February 19, and are available here.  
 
An exciting new take on one of Universal’s iconic Classic Monsters, The Mummy introduced moviegoers to dashing French foreign legionnaire Rick O’Connell (Academy Award® winner Brendan Fraser) and whip-smart scholar and librarian Evelyn (Academy Award® winner Rachel Weisz), sending them on a mythology-inspired adventure through 1920s Egypt. The literary phenomenon from #1 New York Times bestselling author Colleen Hoover becomes a transformative feature film about motherhood, forgiveness and the power of love to overcome even the worst mistake. 

After a perfect outing with her boyfriend, Kenna (Maika Monroe; The Hand that Rocks the Cradle, Longlegs) makes an unbearable mistake that sends her to prison. Seven years later, Kenna returns to her hometown in Wyoming, hoping to rebuild her life and earn the chance to reunite with her young daughter, Diem, whom she has never known.
